instruction.name: vst
instruction.description: Write whole vector data in `data` to memory address `addr + offset`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; vreplgr2vr.b $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; vreplgr2vr.b $vr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; vreplgr2vr.b $vr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; vreplgr2vr.b $vr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; vreplgr2vr.b $vr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; vreplgr2vr.b $vr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; vreplgr2vr.b $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; vreplgr2vr.b $vr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; vreplgr2vr.b $vr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; vreplgr2vr.b $vr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; vreplgr2vr.b $vr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; vreplgr2vr.b $vr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4' --asm 'vst $vr0, $r20, 0; vst $vr1, $r20, 16; vst $vr2, $r20, 32; vst $vr3, $r20, 48; vst $vr4, $r20, 64; vst $vr5, $r20, 80; vst $vr6, $r20, 96; vst $vr7, $r20, 112'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.01 cycles. Buffer is 64-byte aligned; unaligned LASX loads/stores are substantially slower.

notes: Vector memory operation. Throughput measured with a hot, 64-byte-aligned 1KB stack buffer; latency not measured because it depends on cache/coherence state and needs a separate dependency chain.
